instruction:
Create ROADMAP.md as a table: item | status | owner | target (YYYY-MM). Include at least 6 unshipped items spanning the approved/pending work (core training site, tier gates, beta test, campaign, site-health fixes, docs refresh). Assign one owner office per row (CTO, COO, CMO, CXO). Ensure furthest target month starts ≥ 60 days from today. Validate with `python3 .benzene/checks/roadmap.py` if it exists, otherwise manual review against the roadmap-90-days bar. ## Acceptance checks available per office - cto: verify:showcase, verify:template-integrity, verify:template-agents, verify:todo-stability, verify:site-build, verify:site-health, verify:no-secrets, verify:courses, verify:seo, verify:pricing-sync, verify:checkout, verify:learner-journey, verify:pricing-has-free, verify:pricing-has-lifetime, verify:pricing-no-extra-slugs, verify:agents-doc, verify:terminology-docs, verify:skill-doc - cmo: verify:articles, verify:blog-cadence, verify:syndication, verify:newsletter, verify:linkedin, verify:x, verify:instagram, verify:facebook, verify:boosts, verify:youtube - cxo: verify:analytics, verify:analytics-report, verify:feedback-log, verify:beta - cfo: verify:pricing, verify:finance-docs, verify:paypal-sandbox - cio: verify:pitch, verify:pitch-structure, verify:pitch-completion-minimums, verify:traction ## What a step is Work in the workspace's files, done by a cell with the workspace tools. No step runs a command or a check, commits, pushes, opens or updates a pull request or its status, publishes, or waits for a person's answer: the organisation runs the checks after each step, records the work and publishes it itself. The file work such an ask contains (the post, the fix, the note) is a step; only the rest is left out. When nothing remains, the plan has no steps and its problem says why. ## The checks that found this work - verify:site-health (cto): Every built page outside demos, assets, storybooks, skills and blog drafts has no broken internal link, no without alt (unless role=presentation) and exactly one

. Target: 0 findings: 0 broken links, 0 images without alt, 1 h1 per page. says now: `python3 .benzene/checks/site.py health` failed (exit 1): site.health: 110 img-alt, 102 broken-link, 6 one-h1 (218 findings) FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/accessibility-is-not-a-checklist.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/accessible-forms-labels-and-errors.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/actions-are-messages-not-setters.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/agent-skills-are-reusable-knowledge.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-and-accessibility.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-and-technical-debt.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-cannot-hold-your-architecture.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-generated-tests-need-a-human-oracle.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-harness-for-ui-and-state.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/ai-in-the-frontend-sdlc.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/atoms-molecules-organisms.html -> /skills FAIL site.health [broken-link] blog/code-splitting-ships-less-javascript.html -> /skills ... 206 more: fix these first, the next run lists the rest A cell writes files and runs no command: a check runs by itself, in the office's guardrail after each attempt and as a step's acceptance after the step. So no step runs a check, re-runs it or reports what it says. Every step says what to change in which files, from what the checks say above, and the step that closes a check names it as its acceptance (a verifier the office runs, by name; else the acceptance given above); the organisation sends the step to the cells held to that check, when the office has any.
